title: Chopped Chimichurri Steak Salad
description: Grilled steak chopped over crisp greens and cucumber with a garlicky, herby chimichurri dressing.
steps: Blend the parsley, garlic, vinegar, lemon juice and oil into a chimichurri.
Grill the steak to your preferred doneness, rest, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
Toss the greens and cucumber with some chimichurri, top with the steak and more chimichurri.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste chopped chimichurri steak salad

notes: Make extra chimichurri — it keeps a week in the fridge and works on chicken or fish too.
